content: On all datasets except Yelp2013, we use the publicly available 300-dimensional pre-trained Google News vectors ($D$=300) BIBREF50 to initialize the node representations $\mathbf {H}^0$. On Yelp2013, we follow BIBREF27 and learn our own word vectors from the training and validation sets with the gensim implementation of word2vec BIBREF51.
